name: Kpopping Online Wallpapers
description: Search K-pop idols and groups on kpopping.com from the Wallpapers tab, filtered by orientation and resolution (SD to 8K) with the same chips as your local filters. Try a photo on the real desktop first, then keep or discard it. Kept photos are saved as <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/<Group>/<Idol>/<Idol>_<date>_<id>.jpg (group shots in <Group>/mix) and applied the normal way (matugen colours, skwd-wall transition). Searches, album sizes and thumbnails are cached. Also keeps the picker's thumbnails loaded while the dashboard is closed, so it reopens without reloading them.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Queries kpopping.com's public API (no login, no cookies) when you search in Kpopping mode

Downloads thumbnails (via kpopping.com's image resizer) and full-size photos (from its Cloudflare R2 bucket) into ~/.cache/ambxst/kpopping; thumbnails unused for 30 days and previews older than 7 days are deleted, except a preview that is still your wallpaper
Copies the photo you pick into <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/
Desktop previews set the cached photo as your wallpaper (colours included) until you keep or discard it
